source_findings: Original equations give K_R z_g = -K_RE,g x_E,g, so fixed + sum(z_g) = full retained state; no independent beam intervention is represented.
Full and retained states use frame_start=2203. Yaw W*z[5], roll W*z[3], bank z[9]; beta uses the finite-trim airspeed gradient and physical V*z[0:3], with exact zero velocity-reference guard.
The accepted four-output source freezes C16 then C32, matching reducer four[0]; channel ordering matches yaw, roll, sideslip, bank.
Beam grouping covers two disjoint coordinate groups for each of the five beams. Native F3 scale is unchanged; display conversion 180/pi occurs once.
Source has only saved-array reads, scalar arithmetic and plotting, with no matrix products, factorization or solve.
limitations: This review rechecks saved JSON complex sums and all 196 CSV rows, and reads the raw-array recovery source; it does not independently rebuild the earlier resolvent or rerun raw-array recovery.
Signed algebraic contributions depend on the coupled full state and retained resolvent; their size is not a causal sensitivity to changing a beam.
No additional aircraft/reference validation or mesh-convergence conclusion follows.
